**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 3 breaking, 1 feature, 10 fixes.

Three breaking items hide under `refactor:` and `fix:` prefixes, so nobody flagged them. Expired tokens return `401`, not `403`. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from 5 modules. The v1 export route is gone. Please confirm those three, since I read them off commit subjects and the source is not here.

All 16 dep bumps are patch or minor. `vitest` and `esbuild` cross majors but are dev-only. Nothing to tell users.

I left the 10 `perf` commits out. Your headings have no slot for them. Say the word and I add a Performance section.
